wins.label: Strong Q2 Performance
wins.evidence: We delivered strong results, high single-digit revenue growth, margin expansion and high teens adjusted EPS growth.

wins.label: Network Resilience
wins.evidence: We demonstrated the resilience and flexibility we have built into our network and our ongoing efforts to reduce structural costs are leading to significant improvements in profitability.

wins.label: Raised EPS Outlook
wins.evidence: Given the strength of our Q2 results and our updated assumptions for the second half, we are raising our adjusted EPS outlook to $17.80 to $19.

wins.label: B2B Growth
wins.evidence: Nearly half of our revenue growth was driven by B2B services, an important enabler of increased profitability.

wins.label: Spinoff Progress
wins.evidence: FedEx Freight's entire executive leadership team is now in place, and the team is moving quickly to prepare for the separation.

risks.label: MD-11 Grounding Impact
risks.evidence: The grounding of our MD-11 fleet pressured our Q2 adjusted operating income by about $25 million.

risks.label: LTL Industry Weakness
risks.evidence: Freight results remain pressured, driven primarily by lower volumes, partially offset by higher weight and revenue per shipment.

risks.label: Global Trade Policy Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The impact of global trade policy changes continues to create headwinds for our business.

risks.label: Spinoff Costs
risks.evidence: We expect $100 million of the $300 million impact to be due to separation costs.

risks.label: Variable Incentive Compensation
risks.evidence: We have embedded a higher accrual for variable incentive compensation in our revised outlook.

wins.label: Strong Q2 Performance
wins.evidence: Revenue was up 7% year-over-year, margin expansion and high teens adjusted EPS growth.

wins.label: Network 2.0 Progress
wins.evidence: 24% of eligible average daily volume flowing through Network 2.0 optimized facilities.

wins.label: B2B Growth
wins.evidence: Nearly half of FEC revenue growth was driven by B2B services.

wins.label: Yield Management
wins.evidence: U.S. domestic package yield was up over 5%, driven by higher revenue growth.

wins.label: Strategic Collaboration with ServiceNow
wins.evidence: Launched a global AI program to help teams innovate faster and solve challenges more effectively.

risks.label: LTL Market Pressure
risks.evidence: FedEx Freight adjusted operating income declined by $70 million and adjusted operating margin contracted 3 percentage points.

risks.label: International Export Headwind
risks.evidence: International export volumes declined, driven again by lower volumes on the China to U.S. lane.

risks.label: MD-11 Groundings Impact
risks.evidence: Q2 adjusted operating income impacted by approximately $25 million due to the MD-11 groundings.

risks.label: Global Trade Policy Changes
risks.evidence: Multiple headwinds including the unexpected grounding of our MD-11 fleet, nationwide air traffic constraints, weakness in the industrial economy and of course, the impact of global trade policy changes.

risks.label: Uncertainty in LTL Industry
risks.evidence: Continued pressure on average daily shipments in the LTL business.
